title: When the National Anthem Plays at the World Cup 🇺🇸⚽
script: The stadium falls silent. Every voice in 80,000 joins as one. Your national flag fills your chest with something you can't explain. Chills. Every single time. You sing every word even though you don't know all of them. You point to the crest like you're on the team. In that 90 seconds, you are the loudest patriot in that stadium. This is what being a fan really means.
prompt_for_hailuo: Young woman with long auburn hair, wearing her country's colors jersey, standing in packed World Cup stadium, hand over heart during national anthem [Static wide shot showing full stadium, flags from many nations visible]. She closes her eyes, lips moving as she sings, proud tears forming in her eyes [Push in on her emotional face, stadium lights glowing behind her]. Second clip: she raises a large national flag above her head as the anthem swells, crowd behind her doing the same [Tracking shot rising to reveal sea of identical flags]. Dramatic stadium lighting, national colors illuminated, emotional atmosphere, cinematic aerial quality, 9:16 portrait.
